title: Christmas at Mistletoe Manor
description: When a cooking show influencer travels to a centuries-old English castle to honor a World War II nurse, she finds herself swept up by the castle's holiday magic and the unexpected warmth of its charming proprietor.

title: A Royal Icing Christmas

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E25 — The Case of the Punch in the Nose
Barney comes across a 19-year-old assault case file between Floyd and Mr. Foley. Determined to officially close the case, he tries to get statements from the parties involved.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E26 — Opie's Newspaper
Opie and his friend Howie make their own newspaper, the Mayberry Sun, but nobody buys it. After Andy and Barney encourage him to print more interesting stories, Opie decides to publish all the gossip from around town.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E27 — Aunt Bee's Invisible Beau
Aunt Bee pretends that she is dating a married man to avoid being a third wheel after Clara convinces her that she is preventing romance from blossoming between Andy and Helen.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E28 — The Arrest of the Fun Girls
When two young women get a speeding ticket, they enjoy the attention from Andy and Barney.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E29 — The Luck of Newton Monroe
A traveling salesman who sells items out of the trunk of his car arrives in Mayberry. However, he is plagued with bad luck and everything he touches turns into a minor disaster.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E30 — Opie Flunks Arithmetic
Barney helps Opie with his schoolwork by using a teaching method of his own.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E31 — Opie and the Carnival
Opie tries to win a birthday present for his father at a carnival shooting gallery without knowing that it is a scam.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E32 — Banjo-Playing Deputy
A carnival's destitute banjo player is hired to take Barney's place.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S06 E01 — Opie's Job
Opie gets a part-time job in a grocery store but gives it up because another boy needs the job more.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S06 E02 — Andy's Rival
Andy is jealous when he realizes that a handsome teacher is spending evenings with Helen.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S06 E03 — Malcolm at the Crossroads
Andy hires a rock-throwing rustic as a school crossing guard.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S06 E04 — Aunt Bee, the Swinger
Aunt Bee and her new boyfriend discover that they aren't as young as they think.

title: God's Country Song

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E24 — The Stranger
As Ben prepares to run for governor, Joe must come to his rescue when a disabled police officer from New Orleans comes to arrest Ben on a 20-year-old murder charge.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E25 — Escape to the Ponderosa
Adam is taken hostage by a band of U.S. Army prisoners who have escaped and sought refuge on the Ponderosa.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E26 — The Avenger
A wanderer seeking his parents' lynchers, arrives in Virginia City as Ben and Adam are convicted of murder.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E27 — The Last Trophy
Two British socialites find that they still have a lot to learn when they visit their friends, the Cartwrights.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E28 — San Francisco
Shortly after the Ponderosa cattle herd arrives in San Francisco at the hands of Hoss, Joe and Ben, two of their trail drivers are shanghaied and destined for Hong Kong.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E29 — Bitter Water
When a neighbor agrees to sell his property, the Cartwrights fear the loss of water rights for their cattle.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E30 — Feet of Clay
The Cartwrights befriend a boy whose father has been sent to jail and whose mother has recently died.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E31 — Dark Star
Little Joe falls for a girl who has been disowned by her people because they think she is a witch and, therefore, an outcast.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E32 — Death at Dawn
A member of a powerful gang murders a shopkeeper; the deputized Cartwrights sentence a murderer to hang at dawn when the leader of the gang kidnaps Ben and holds him hostage.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E01 — Showdown
A young bank robber gets a job on the Ponderosa to prevent the sheriff from finding the other members of his gang.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E02 — The Mission
Hoss befriends Charlie Trent, a man who went from top Army scout to town drunk after he led his troops into a massacre.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E03 — Badge Without Honor
A Deputy U.S. Marshal arrives to escort a man to California to testify against a gang; guest Dan Duryea.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E04 — The Mill
Ben tries to help his paraplegic neighbor Tom by setting up a grain mill on his unused land; Tom's hired hand raises his suspicion about Ben's plan.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E05 — The Hopefuls
Outlaws plot to steal a trunk containing the savings of a religious group heading for a new life in the West.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E06 — Denver McKee
The Cartwrights' neighbor (Franchot Tone), a former soldier and lawman, seeks security for his daughter.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E07 — Day of Reckoning
Bigoted Ike Daggett takes action when Ben gives an Indian and his wife land after the Indian saves his life.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E08 — The Abduction
Hoss and Little Joe spend the most unforgettable night at the carnival when Little Joe's date disappears.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E09 — Breed of Violence
A sheriff's daughter runs off with her boyfriend (John Ericson), unaware he is a murderous bank robber.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E10 — The Last Viking
For saving his life, Ben offers some Ponderosa farmland to an American Indian.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E11 — The Trail Gang
An outlaw joins the Cartwrights' cattle drive, knowing it will take him to the town where his father is the sheriff.
